digest.component_or_area: workflow editor server and effective policy view
propositions: The workflow editor must display an immutable, read-only Effective Policy view derived from CriteriaSnapshot alongside the editable Authored Workflow topology to prevent conflicting policy authorities.
Project code-review LLM criteria with missing, empty, or blank applies_to globs must be rejected at save validation with actionable remediation suggesting ["**"] for repository-wide scope.
Effective Policy changes must update only the derived read-only view while the authored YAML/BPMN document round-trips unchanged and is never mutated by effective state.
CriteriaSnapshot load or validation failures must render Effective Policy unavailable with a located, actionable error and prevent save; packaged defaults must never be substituted silently.
Built-in secondary triggers, project DET selectors, and plan-review applies_at/trigger authoring retain their original trigger controls and are exempt from the project-LLM glob validation rule.
